purpose: Спроектировать автоматизированную поставку AI-сервиса: IaC, CI/CD, MLOps, Model Registry и безопасный Canary-релиз 1% → 5% → 100% с измеримыми rollback gates.

schema.notation: COMMIT → BUILD → UNIT TESTS → SECURITY/QUALITY GATES → STAGING → E2E → RELEASE MANIFEST → CANARY 1% → CANARY 5% → PROD 100% → OBSERVE / ROLLBACK
schema.description: Homework требует IaC для K8s/S3, CI/CD от commit до prod, связь с обучением/Model Registry и Canary. MLOps lane связывает dataset update, orchestration/retrain, evaluation, Model Registry and deployment trigger.

visual.alt: Lesson 20 automated AI delivery with CI/CD, MLOps Model Registry and Canary 1 percent, 5 percent and 100 percent rollout.

curriculum.summary: Стратегии Blue-Green, Canary и Rolling; планирование релиза; readiness checklist; rollback plan; практика — план релиза AI-сервиса с Canary.
requirements: Infrastructure as Code: описать автоматически создаваемые K8s cluster и S3 buckets
CI/CD: Commit → Build Docker → Unit Tests → Deploy Staging → E2E Tests → Deploy Prod
MLOps: показать связь dataset update → orchestrator → retrain → Model Registry → CI/CD trigger
Canary: описать переключение 1% → 5% → 100% и rollback metrics
homework: Связать код приложения с model artifact / Model Registry
acceptance_criteria: Интеграция: связь между кодом приложения и артефактом модели (Model Registry)
Безопасность релиза: наличие этапов тестирования и стратегии Canary/Blue-Green
Автоматизация: минимум ручных действий в схеме

architect_pro.summary: GitOps separates build from deployment: CI produces immutable app/model/index references; Git stores desired deployment state; Argo CD reconciles live state to Git. Canary progression is an explicit release state machine with automatic metric gates and immediate traffic rollback to stable on failure.
methods: Immutable app image digest + model URI/version + vector-index version in one release manifest
Keep stable version live during canary
Separate Canary release risk control from A/B hypothesis testing
anti_patterns: Deploy latest tag without immutable digest/version
Model artifact not bound to application release
Canary without metrics and rollback condition
Removing stable version before canary completes
Treating A/B test and canary release as the same experiment
Rollback that requires rebuilding an old version

father_production.summary: DZ20 is the first submission-grade composition of FATHER Delivery, Model Registry, Evaluation, Security, Observability/SLO and Kubernetes blocks. It is also the target blueprint for the future reusable DevOps/DevSecOps Factory.
runtime_notes: CI builds immutable artifacts; deployment is GitOps-driven
Release manifest binds app image, model version and RAG/index version
Canary traffic stages are independent release gates
Stable remains available until 100% promotion is complete
Rollback redirects traffic to stable and restores previous release manifest
Runtime thresholds in submission are design choices and must be calibrated from real SLO/evidence

evidence: Submission package explicitly maps all four homework steps.
Release manifest binds application image digest to model registry URI/version and RAG index version.
Canary policy specifies 1% → 5% → 100% progression and rollback signals.
IaC pseudocode declares VPC/network, Kubernetes cluster and S3/object storage targets.
MLOps pipeline shows dataset/source update → validation → retrain/reindex → evaluation → registry → release trigger.
GitOps design uses Git desired state and Argo CD reconciliation; runtime execution evidence is not claimed.
traceability: GIT DESIRED STATE → ARGO CD → KUBERNETES
gaps: Homework is prepared but still marked not submitted until uploaded to OTUS.
Terraform is submission pseudocode/design, not proof of a cloud deployment.
Argo CD architecture is used as GitOps reference; an installed Argo CD runtime is not claimed.
Canary thresholds are project design values, not values supplied by OTUS or Martin Fowler.
Model Registry implementation is abstract; MLflow or another registry can be selected later.
Runtime CI/CD, Canary and rollback evidence can be added after DZ18/DZ19 labs are executed.
